# Evan Borden — Engineering Manager & Adobe Architect

> Evan Borden is an engineering manager and Adobe solutions architect based in Charlotte, North Carolina. He has eighteen years of experience building software and seven years leading the engineers who build it. At Razorfish he serves as technical lead across three flagship client accounts — Disney Rewards, UC Health and Labcorp OnDemand.

Site: https://www.evanborden.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/evan-borden/
Email: evanpatrickborden@outlook.com
Location: Charlotte, NC, United States
Currently: Manager of Engineering at Razorfish (November 2018 – present)
Open to: Engineering Manager, Director of Engineering, Technical Director, Solutions Architect

## Summary

Evan Borden leads front-end and back-end engineering teams of up to 10 people across multi-year enterprise client engagements. His background runs from enterprise WordPress and Adobe Experience Manager platforms to the wider Adobe cloud stack — App Builder, Experience Platform and Journey Optimizer — and modern CI/CD on GitLab and Azure DevOps. He hires engineers directly onto his teams across the US, India and Costa Rica, partners daily with VP-and-above technical leaders, and is known by name to the CTO.

## Current work: Labcorp OnDemand (2026)

On Labcorp OnDemand, Razorfish's newest flagship account, Evan served as **Adobe architect and technical director**, owning the end-to-end architecture and leading the delivery team on a compressed timeline. The implementation spans:

- **AEM as a Cloud Service (AEMaaCS)** — content architecture, editable templates, Cloud Manager pipelines, and the delivery layer for Thrive Global content.
- **Adobe App Builder** — the extensibility and integration tier: custom services and React UI extensions wiring AEMaaCS to Adobe Experience Platform and Journey Optimizer.
- **Adobe I/O** — serverless actions on I/O Runtime, event-driven integration through I/O Events, and project, workspace and credential setup via the aio CLI and Developer Console.
- **Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)** — the unified customer profile: datasets and data ingestion, identity stitching, and segment definitions feeding downstream activation.
- **Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)** — journey, campaign and channel configuration on AEP profiles: event triggers, audience entry, channel surfaces, and message templates.
- **Decision Management / Offer Decisioning** — offer catalog, decision rules and selection strategies governing what each profile is served.
- **XDM schema modeling** — XDM class and schema design, field groups and identity maps underpinning the profile.
- **Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection** — tag configuration and a datastream routing events into AEP and Journey Optimizer.

- **Unity FPS** (personal, multi-year) — DOOM-style first-person shooter in Unity and C#, with Unity MCP, custom Claude connectors, and AI art and map-generation pipelines.
